source: Frozen expansion acquisition run 35447995157 only. No provider calls. Selectively restore existing authorized dailyDevelopment/intradayDevelopment dates using unchanged admission.plan/restore. Retain Exposure Ledger and original results.
sameAsOf: Use union of already acquired authorized daily payload dates for daily histories, intradayDevelopment only for minute histories; excluded calendar dates reset history, never read payload. Both lanes snapshot at the last authorized intraday session close. Peer fit/normalization/reference residual scale trained in that snapshot's past window only. Profile computedThrough and all artifactThrough <= asOf < decisionTime. No inference that endpoints prove observed PIT availability.

snapshot.dailyLongHistory: All 733 prior authorized sessions plus already authorized intraday daily payloads; no new acquisition

targets: Existing 9 lane-USABLE and 23 calibration-only lane-WATCH, plus separate Pullback vNext/old comparator. Frozen global verdicts never replaced.
sampleConfidence: Existing HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW policy retained, but reference residual SD is recomputed only from each causal training snapshot, not the later frozen full-period A fit. Therefore new synchronized counts need not equal archived counts.

walkForward.primaryTrain: 60 exchange calendar positions ending at anchor
walkForward.auxiliaryTrain: expanding authorized history ending at same anchor
walkForward.selection: Dates and all symbols, never return-based; test dates after 5 exchange-session embargo, 20 authorized intraday dates; target matrices retain excluded calendar positions as NaN

temporalPolicy.meaning: Separate descriptive Development temporal screen; NOT confirmatory symbol p-values. All conditions conjunctive, unknown fails closed; source H/M and target sample minima required per fold; no threshold tuning. Sign uses frozen-source-peer residuals. Magnitude/calibration/bias normalized by source residual SD. Drift and recent/long snapshots reported separately; current drift true excludes dispatch.

watchMapping: One intercept+slope OLS mapping from source posterior residual to target residual fitted cross-sectionally on fold1 only (>=100 pairs); frozen mapping tested on folds2/3. Require each >=100 pairs, calibration slope 0.5..1.5 and mapped MSE <= identity MSE in BOTH; report sign consistency and coverage. Only new-version candidate; never dispatch or promote old WATCH. No fit on test folds.

pullback.definition: Confirmed upward close swing followed immediately by confirmed downward close swing in same contiguous session AM/PM segment, sharing peak anchor; correction amplitude / upward amplitude, no clipping; fixed 0.5*(priorClose*S) reversal. S from prior 10 authorized sessions, >=5 valid true ranges. Downward leg usable only at upward reversal confirmation. Reset on missing5m/lunch/day. No eligible pair => null. Record each event, per-session mean, event-pair count and event-bearing sessions separately.
pullback.comparison: Same eligible Development symbol-session old scalar comparator; no old overwrite, no automatic new-trait USABLE claim. Use same walk-forward diagnostic as other traits.

reader: Implement prior correction-spec.json exactly: explicit daily.Date/barValue adapter, verified prior exchange session, complete closed5m, current-phase expected end floor(t/5)*5, age<=4min, no auction substitution, missing/stale/future/duplicate rejected or reason-coded unavailable. Cumulative VWAP only complete session prefix; missing prefix => VWAP null, not manufactured. Explicit units and feature-level missing reasons. Shared Entry/EXIT context; no trade decisions.
identity: Code is join key only, never predictor. Preserve dated master membership and reject corporate-action rows by unchanged v0 action filter. No claim of permanent issuer identity across unverified corporate restructurings; dispatch research-only with explicit identity evidence.
handoff: READY only if same-as-of/no-leak/history/freshness/session/determinism contracts pass, real Development temporal measurement completed, coverage fixed, Pullback results fixed, and at least one USABLE H/M temporal-PASS symbol-trait is actually dispatchable with same-as-of artifacts and valid Reader. Otherwise BLOCKED and STOP. No Entry/EXIT designs when BLOCKED. READY permits design only, no training/optimization.
stop: After tests/regression/deterministic regeneration/CI/Evidence/handoff. No main merge. Any unavailable raw/secret/permission is a blocker, not permission to acquire or bypass.
